title: Booking: Links I made now shows who booked
text: On Booking, Links and calls, once someone books through a link, the row shows who they are: their name with their email underneath. A link made for "Someone new" now shows the real booker instead. If the booker is not the person the link was made for (a different email or name), the row says "Booked by" in amber so it is easy to spot. Pointing at the name also shows their phone, any answers they gave and, when Calendly sends them, their first and last name separately.
points: Open Booking, then Links and calls, and look at the For column of a booked row
Point at the name to see the booker's phone, answers and first and last name
